best_idea: Draw an overhead health bar only while the value is below full, colour it by two linear clamps (red to yellow to green), and reuse the same bar as the neutral capture meter.
decision_why: Keep the hide-at-full rule, the two-clamp colour ramp and the capture-meter reuse, take the fill fix, and reject the 2D tile offsets and crack sprite stages because a third-person 3D world needs a screen-space bar.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone an engaged enemy shows no bar at full health; at half health the fill is half the track (a test asserts a width ratio of 0.5 within 1 px); the colour is red at 0, yellow at half and green at full; and at most three enemy bars are drawn at once.
